summary: Manage Excel Links now lists one row per dataset or DFM method, with resizable, filterable columns and more row actions.
details: A workbook used by two datasets shows two rows naming them, replacing the "2 datasets" summary cell.
Clicking a name opens that dataset in Dataset Viewer or that method in the DFM page.
The row menu adds Open workbook, Open workbook as Read-Only, and - on a Folder cell - Open folder in File Explorer.
Columns resize by dragging a header edge (double-click restores the default width) and filter from the header, like the dataset table.
Method Type shows the same value as the dataset table's column.
The Status column is gone; a workbook ArcRho Server cannot open is marked on its name instead.
